content.json:
# Azure AI estate and lifecycle review

Inspect Azure AI accounts, deployments, model lifecycle data, Foundry projects, and retirement signals across selected subscriptions. Use the estate report to apply the approved scope, tags, regions, and exceptions.

parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.label: Subscriptions
parameters.query: ResourceContainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | where properties.state =~ 'Enabled' | project value = subscriptionId, label = name, selected = true | order by label asc

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query: Resources | where type in~ ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts', 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces') | summarize count() by resourceGroup | project value = resourceGroup, label = resourceGroup, selected = false | order by label asc

parameters.name: ModelAccount
parameters.label: Model account
parameters.query: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' | where kind in~ ('OpenAI', 'AIServices') | extend groups = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}]) | where array_length(groups) == 0 or set_has_element(groups, '*') or set_has_element(groups, resourceGroup) | project value = id, label = strcat(name, ' [', kind, ']'), selected = false | order by label asc

parameters.name: AccountSubscription
parameters.label: Account subscription
parameters.query: Resources | where tolower(id) == tolower('{ModelAccount}') | project value = subscriptionId, label = subscriptionId, selected = true

parameters.name: AccountRegion
parameters.label: Account region
parameters.query: Resources | where tolower(id) == tolower('{ModelAccount}') | project value = location, label = location, selected = true

parameters.name: AccountKind
parameters.label: Account kind
parameters.query: Resources | where tolower(id) == tolower('{ModelAccount}') | project value = tostring(kind), label = tostring(kind), selected = true

content.query: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' | extend groups = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}]) | where array_length(groups) == 0 or set_has_element(groups, '*') or set_has_element(groups, resourceGroup) | summarize Accounts = count(), ModelHosts = countif(kind in~ ('OpenAI', 'AIServices')), PublicAccessEnabled = countif(tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess) =~ 'Enabled'), LocalAuthEnabled = countif(tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true) by Kind = tostring(kind) | order by Accounts desc
content.title: Azure AI accounts by kind

content.query: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' | extend groups = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}]) | where array_length(groups) == 0 or set_has_element(groups, '*') or set_has_element(groups, resourceGroup) | join kind=leftouter (ResourceContainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId | project Account = name, Subscription, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, Kind = tostring(kind), Region = location, SKU = tostring(sku.name), State = tostring(properties.provisioningState), PublicNetworkAccess = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess), LocalAuthDisabled = tostring(properties.disableLocalAuth), Identity = tostring(identity.type), Tags = tostring(tags) | order by Subscription asc, Account asc
content.title: Accounts and current posture

content.json:
## Deployments and model lifecycle

Choose a model account above. Deployment data comes from the Azure Resource Manager control plane because Resource Graph does not expose model deployments.

content.query: Resources | where tolower(id) == tolower('{ModelAccount}') | project Account = name, SubscriptionId = subscriptionId, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, Region = location, Kind = tostring(kind), ResourceId = id
content.title: Selected model account

content.query: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces' | extend groups = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}]) | where array_length(groups) == 0 or set_has_element(groups, '*') or set_has_element(groups, resourceGroup) | join kind=leftouter (ResourceContainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId | project Workspace = name, Subscription, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, Kind = tostring(kind), Region = location, HubResourceId = tostring(properties.hubResourceId), PublicNetworkAccess = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess), ManagedNetwork = tostring(properties.managedNetwork.isolationMode), Identity = tostring(identity.type), State = tostring(properties.provisioningState) | order by Subscription asc, Workspace asc
content.title: Foundry projects, hubs, and Azure Machine Learning workspaces

content.json:
## Service retirements, Advisor, and resource health

Service Health announces change. Azure Advisor identifies affected resources and suggested actions. Resource Health shows the current availability state.

content.query: ServiceHealthResources | where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/events' | extend EventType = tostring(properties.EventType), EventSubType = tostring(properties.EventSubType), Status = tostring(properties.Status), TrackingId = tostring(properties.TrackingId), Title = tostring(properties.Title), Summary = tostring(properties.Summary), EventDate = todatetime(tolong(properties.ImpactMitigationTime)) | where EventType == 'HealthAdvisory' and EventSubType == 'Retirement' | extend SearchText = tolower(strcat(Title, ' ', Summary)) | where SearchText has_any ('azure openai', 'microsoft foundry', 'cognitive services', 'ai services', 'machine learning') | project TrackingId, Title, Summary, Status, EventDate, SubscriptionId = subscriptionId | order by EventDate asc
content.title: Azure AI service retirement advisories

content.query: AdvisorResources | where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations' | extend RecommendationSubCategory = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.recommendationSubCategory), State = tostring(properties.platformState), ResourceId = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)), Impact = tostring(properties.impact), Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem), Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution) | where RecommendationSubCategory == 'ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement' and State == 'New' | join kind=inner (Resources | where type in~ ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts', 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces') | extend groups = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}]) | where array_length(groups) == 0 or set_has_element(groups, '*') or set_has_element(groups, resourceGroup) | project ResourceId = tolower(id), Resource = name, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, Region = location) on ResourceId | project Resource, ResourceGroup, Region, Impact, Problem, Solution | order by Impact asc, Resource asc
content.title: Open retirement recommendations for Azure AI resources

content.query: HealthResources | where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses' | extend ResourceId = tolower(tostring(properties.targetResourceId)), Availability = tostring(properties.availabilityState), Summary = tostring(properties.summary), Occurred = todatetime(properties.occurredTime) | join kind=inner (Resources | where type in~ ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts', 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces') | extend groups = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}]) | where array_length(groups) == 0 or set_has_element(groups, '*') or set_has_element(groups, resourceGroup) | project ResourceId = tolower(id), Resource = name, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup) on ResourceId | project Resource, ResourceGroup, Availability, Summary, Occurred | order by Availability asc, Resource asc
content.title: Resource health
